name: Signal Jammer - Dodge
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Dodge capability.

61176.name: TacW DMG Reduction II · Dodge
61176.SpecificEffects:
When attacked by a Tactical Weapon, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-25%</color>.
In combat, the enemy's Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.
ST's Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
